photos.desc: A cladogram of the evolution of tetrapods showing the best-known transitional fossils. From bottom to top: Eusthenopteron, Panderichthys, Tiktaalik, Acanthostega, Ichthyostega, Pederpes.
Panderichthys , a sarcopterygian fish from the late Devonian of Latvia, pencil drawing
Illustration of the Sarcopterygiin fish Panderichthys . Originally made for a school project.
Comparison between the fins of lobe-finned fishes ( Sarcopterygii ) and legs of early tetrapods. 1. Tiktaalik . 2. Panderichthys . 3. Eusthenopteron . 4. Acanthostega . 5. Ichthyostega ( hindleg ).
Fossil - Took the picture at Musee d'Histoire Naturelle, Lille
Comparison between the limbs of Sarcopterygiin fishes and tetrapods. A. EN:Eusthenopteron B. EN:Gogonasus C. EN:Panderichthys D. EN:Tiktaalik E. EN:Acanthostega F. EN:Ichthyostega ( hindleg ), and G.
